constraints: RESEARCH_SA consumes the BB-084 desired contract and BB-083 research as design inputs; the Worker binds only DONE BB-084 package-root exports.
Persistence reuses delivered createJsonImmutableArtifactStore for immutable artifacts and delivered createJsonCasHeadStore compare-and-swap for the per-episode head; no new store implementation.
Only an application principal verified by an injected principalAuthority can create or revise a response or resolve an episode.
The lifecycle ends at FeedbackResolution and imports nothing from BB-059, BB-065, optimizer or pattern code.
Unknown, missing, stale or unresolved evidence yields UNKNOWN or an unresolved state, never success.
invariants: Finding and impact are evidence; they grant no disposition, acceptance, lifecycle or promotion authority.
Every lifecycle transition is made by a verified application principal against the exact expected head revision, and exact replay converges without a second mutation.
An outcome is fresh only when bound to the current response and to grounded evidence strictly after the response; otherwise it is UNKNOWN.
UNKNOWN never resolves an episode, and resolution values are derived from recorded state rather than chosen by the caller.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Add three modules in packages/agentic-system/src: feedback-lifecycle-contracts.js (FEEDBACK_EPISODE_V1, FEEDBACK_RESPONSE_V1, FEEDBACK_OUTCOME_POLICY_V1, FEEDBACK_OUTCOME_V1, FEEDBACK_RESOLUTION_V1 validators), feedback-outcome.js (pure classifyFeedbackOutcome) and feedback-lifecycle-controller.js (createFeedbackLifecycleController + createJsonFeedbackEpisodeHeadStore). Exports added to index.js only.

D2 — FEEDBACK_EPISODE_V1 = {groundedInputRefs[{ref,digest}], finding:{kind, statement, evidenceRefs, producer:{kind OBSERVER|MODEL|HUMAN|APPLICATION, id}}, impact:{basis MEASURED|HYPOTHESIZED, measurements[]}, scopeKey, contraryEvidenceRefs[]}. episodeId = sha256(canonical(episode)). MEASURED requires every input GROUNDED under BB-084 validation plus consumption recheck; otherwise basis must be HYPOTHESIZED.

D3 — Episode head key = 'feedback-episode:'+episodeId in a head store created by createJsonFeedbackEpisodeHeadStore(options), which returns the delivered createJsonCasHeadStore(options). Head value = {episodeRef, state, responseRef|null, outcomeRef|null, resolutionRef|null}. Every transition is compareAndSwap(key, expectedRevision, next).

D4 — States: OPEN -> RESPONDED_ACTED -> OUTCOME_RECORDED -> RESOLVED; OPEN|RESPONDED_DEFERRED -> RESPONDED_REJECTED|RESPONDED_SUPERSEDED -> RESOLVED; OPEN -> RESPONDED_DEFERRED -> (revisit) any response. RESOLVED is terminal. UNKNOWN outcome leaves RESPONDED_ACTED so a later fresh outcome or a new DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED response is possible.

D5 — FEEDBACK_RESPONSE_V1 = {episodeRef+digest, previousResponseRef|null, principalAuthorityRef, disposition ACTED|REJECTED|DEFERRED|SUPERSEDED, rationaleRef, actionRefs[], successorEpisodeRef|null, revisitCondition:{kind AFTER_EPISODE|AFTER_REVISION|MANUAL, ref|null}|null, outcomePolicy|null}. ACTED requires GROUNDED inputs, non-empty actionRefs and a frozen outcomePolicy; SUPERSEDED requires successorEpisodeRef; DEFERRED requires revisitCondition; REJECTED requires rationaleRef.

D6 — Principal: the controller accepts principal only as an explicit call argument and calls principalAuthority.verifyFeedbackPrincipal({principal, episodeRef, transition}) which must return {authorityRef}; this mirrors the delivered organization-authority verify pattern. Principals of kind OBSERVER, EVALUATOR, PROVIDER or OPTIMIZER are rejected before verification; principal-like fields inside episode, observation, finding or provider payloads are never read.

D7 — FEEDBACK_OUTCOME_POLICY_V1 = {metricKey, direction HIGHER_IS_BETTER|LOWER_IS_BETTER, minEffect > 0, noChangeBand with 0 <= noChangeBand <= minEffect, requiredMeasurementKeys[]} frozen by digest inside the ACTED response; it cannot be changed after the response.

D8 — Freshness identity = {responseRef+digest, freshInputRef+digest, freshExecutionAttemptIds, effectiveAfterBoundary}. effectiveAfterBoundary is the latest durable observedAtBoundary among the episode's inputs. Fresh input must be a BB-084 GroundedFindingInput not in the episode, pass consumption recheck, bind only execution attempts absent from the episode inputs, and have every boundary strictly later than effectiveAfterBoundary; the response ref must equal the head's current response.

D9 — classifyFeedbackOutcome(policy, baselineMeasurements, freshMeasurements, freshness) is pure: any missing or null required measurement, UNRESOLVED fresh input or failed freshness => UNKNOWN. Else signed delta = (fresh - baseline) * direction; delta >= minEffect => IMPROVED; delta < -noChangeBand => REGRESSED; otherwise NO_CHANGE.

D10 — FEEDBACK_RESOLUTION_V1 = {episodeRef, finalResponseRef, outcomeRef|null, resolution IMPROVED|NO_CHANGE|REGRESSED|REJECTED_ACKNOWLEDGED|SUPERSEDED, principalAuthorityRef}. resolve() derives the value from head state; a caller-supplied value that differs is rejected; UNKNOWN or DEFERRED cannot resolve.

D11 — Idempotency/recovery: artifacts are content-addressed so a retry after a crash between put and compareAndSwap recreates the same ref. On CAS failure the controller reloads the head; if it already equals the intended next value the call returns CONVERGED with no mutation, otherwise STALE_REVISION with no rebase. recover(episodeId) re-resolves every ref, verifies digests and ignores orphan artifacts.

D12 — Worker-start preflight test/feedback-lifecycle-dependency-contract.test.mjs asserts BB-084 DONE with delivery receipt/Living refs and package-root exports for the GroundedFindingInput validator and assertGroundedFindingInputCurrent; mismatch is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION. BB-059/BB-065 are not dependencies; outcome evidence is fresh grounded observation.
implementationSlices: F1 — Dependency preflight [FL5]: implement test/feedback-lifecycle-dependency-contract.test.mjs first per D12; missing BB-084 delivery or export => PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION before product writes.
F2 — Typed contracts [FL1, FL3, INV-1]: implement the five validators and episodeId per D2, D5, D7, D10 with exact ref+digest identity and no implicit authority fields.

F3 — Episode + response controller [FL1, FL2, INV-2]: implement openEpisode and respond with the D3 head store, D4 state machine, D5 disposition rules and D6 principal verification; ACTED refused unless inputs are GROUNDED at consumption.
F4 — Fresh outcome [FL3, INV-3]: implement classifyFeedbackOutcome (D9) and recordOutcome enforcing the D8 freshness identity against the current response; UNKNOWN keeps RESPONDED_ACTED.

F5 — Resolution + recovery [FL2, FL4, INV-2, INV-4]: implement resolve with derived values (D10), CONVERGED/STALE_REVISION replay semantics and recover (D11); prove crash-between-put-and-CAS and fresh-process reconstruction in feedback-lifecycle-recovery.test.js.

F6 — Living truth [FL5]: add docs/living/system/agentic-application/feedback-lifecycle.md describing only the delivered episode/response/outcome/resolution contracts, authority boundaries and limits; export new names; run agentic and repository regressions.

negativeVerificationCases: An episode whose groundedInputRef digest mismatches the stored input, or that references a non-GroundedFindingInput artifact, is rejected.
MEASURED impact with any UNRESOLVED input, or with an input that fails consumption-time currentness recheck, is rejected.

ACTED on an episode with UNRESOLVED or STALE inputs, without actionRefs or without a frozen outcome policy is rejected; REJECTED without rationaleRef, DEFERRED without revisitCondition and SUPERSEDED without successorEpisodeRef are rejected.

A principal of kind OBSERVER, EVALUATOR, PROVIDER or OPTIMIZER, a principal that principalAuthority does not verify, or a principal field embedded in episode, finding or observation payload cannot create, revise or resolve.
Replaying the same respond call after success returns CONVERGED and leaves the head revision unchanged; a stale expectedRevision with different content fails STALE_REVISION without rebase.
A crash after artifact put but before compareAndSwap leaves the head unchanged; retry produces the same artifact ref and one transition; recover ignores the orphan artifact.

An outcome bound to a non-current response, a fresh input already in the episode, an execution attempt present in the baseline inputs or a boundary not strictly after effectiveAfterBoundary is UNKNOWN.
A missing or null required measurement, or an UNRESOLVED fresh input, is UNKNOWN and never IMPROVED; a missing measurement is never coerced to zero.
Changing the outcome policy after the ACTED response is impossible: recordOutcome uses only the policy digest frozen in the response.
resolve() with UNKNOWN outcome or DEFERRED state fails; a caller-supplied resolution value different from the derived value fails; RESOLVED accepts no further transition.
Lifecycle modules importing how-evolution, @exharness/benchmark, optimizer, pattern or BB-083 feedback-*.js code fail the dependency import-graph test.
Worker start with BB-084 not DONE, missing delivery receipt/Living ref or missing package-root export exits PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION before product writes.
